reasoning_content: The installation is essentially complete and verified. Let me do a final check on the WFS GetFeature 400 error (probably just a wrong typename) and wrap up. Actually, GetFeature with a non-existent typename is returning a 400 with an OWS exception. Let me try fetching a typename from the actual capabilities. But this is a trivial additional check — the installation is complete. To be thorough, let me quickly run it with a valid typename, then finalize.

action.command: t=$(timeout 40 curl -s "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities&version=2.0.0" | grep -oE "<TypeName>[^<]+</TypeName>" | head -1 | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g'); echo "typename: $t"; timeout 60 curl -s "http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetFeature&version=2.0.0&typeNames=$t&maxFeatures=1" -o /tmp/gf2.xml -w "GetFeature: %{http_code}, %{size_download} bytes\n"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "t=$(timeout 40 curl -s \"http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities&version=2.0.0\" | grep -oE \"<TypeName>[^<]+</TypeName>\" | head -1 | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g'); echo \"typename: $t\"; timeout 60 curl -s \"http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetFeature&version=2.0.0&typeNames=$t&maxFeatures=1\" -o /tmp/gf2.xml -w \"GetFeature: %{http_code}, %{size_download} bytes\\n\"", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "GetFeature with valid typename"}
